caption: The drawing displays two distinct objects against a plain beige background. The top object is a horizontal, slightly curved rectangular band featuring a decorative floral design. The background of the band is a muted gold or tan color, bordered by two parallel green and black lines along the top and bottom. The floral motifs on the band include green leaves, white and pale blue flowers, and intricate black swirling patterns interspersed with small green elements. The bottom object in the drawing is an oval shape with a predominantly gold background, featuring a large green, yellow, and gray leaf at its center, outlined in black. Several smaller green leaves and round berry-like shapes accompany the main leaf, and there are light gray decorative swirls and accents scattered over the background. The artist's name, "WALTER J. BRASEKE," appears beneath the oval object in small, uppercase letters.
title: Hat Box
